question: Which are the car makers which produce at least 2 models and more than 3 car makers ? List the id and the maker .
initial_sql: SELECT T1.Id, T1.Maker FROM car_makers AS T1 JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker JOIN car_names AS T3 ON T1.Id = T3.MakeId JOIN cars_data AS T4 ON T3.MakeId = T4.Id GROUP BY T1.Id, T1.Maker HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ModelId) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT T4.Id) > 3
sql:
SELECT T1.Id, T1.Maker
FROM car_makers AS T1
JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker
JOIN car_names AS T3 ON T3.Model = T2.Model AND T3.Make = T1.Maker
GROUP BY T1.Id, T1.Maker
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T2.ModelId) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT T3.MakeId) > 3

question: What are the ids and makers of all car makers that produce at least 2 models and make more than 3 cars?
initial_sql:
SELECT Id, Maker
FROM car_makers
WHERE Id IN (
    SELECT Maker
    FROM model_list
    GROUP BY Maker
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
AND Id IN (
    SELECT ml.Maker
    FROM cars_data AS cd
    JOIN car_names AS cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
    JOIN model_list AS ml ON cn.Model = ml.ModelId
    GROUP BY ml.Maker
    HAVING COUNT(cd.Id) > 3
);
sql:
SELECT cm.Id, cm.Maker
FROM car_makers AS cm
JOIN model_list AS ml ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
JOIN car_names AS cn ON cn.Model = ml.ModelId
JOIN cars_data AS cd ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
GROUP BY cm.Id, cm.Maker
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ml.ModelId) >= 2
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT cd.Id) > 3;
